rows.note: For the portable-container sense, this is the all-purpose Cantonese choice.

example.english: We brought a cooler when we went camping.
example.traditional: 我哋去露營嗰陣帶咗個保冷箱。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 lou6 jing4 go2 zan6 daai3 zo2 go3 bou2 laang5 soeng1

rows.note: Use this for an alcoholic fruit-juice drink, especially when the exact wine-based recipe is not important.

example.english: This cooler is sweet and easy to drink.
example.traditional: 呢杯果汁酒甜甜地，好易入口。
example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 gwo2 zap1 zau2 tim4 tim4 dei6 hou2 ji6 jap6 hau2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the refrigerator used to store bodies in a morgue.

example.english: The cooler in the morgue must be managed by authorized staff.
example.traditional: 太平間雪櫃要由專人管理。
example.jyutping: taai3 ping4 gaan1 syut3 gwai6 jiu3 jau4 zyun1 jan4 gun2 lei5
